title: Rules-text words
description: The rules text as this language prints it, one entry per ability of the card, paired by ability_id with the card's structure. An ability's text is the sequence of pieces the printed ability consists of: the words are strings, and every part that is a component (a mana symbol, a keyword) is a reference to that component's ID, so the component holds itself once in its list.

ability_id.description: The ability_id of the ability this text belongs to in the card.

text.description: The pieces of that ability's printed words in this language. A plain string is the words. A piece of kind symbol is the mana symbol that ID names (CR 107.4): the database holds only the ID, and the application assembles the printed notation from it. For an activated ability, the words after the cost's colon (CR 602.1a): the card holds the cost as structure, and the application assembles the printed symbol (the loyalty symbol per CR 107.7) and the colon.

id.description: The ID of a mana symbol (CR 107.4); the application assembles the printed notation from it.
